grammar.d: 表示过去某一时间发生的动作或存在的状态 用于描述过去发生的事件、动作或状态
ex: Last week I went to the theatre.

grammar.k: 情态动词 could 的用法
grammar.f: 主语 + could/could not + 动词原形
grammar.d: could 是 can 的过去式，表示过去的能力或可能性 表示过去能够或不能做某事，用于否定句时表示无法忍受
ex: I could not hear the actors.
In the end, I could not bear it.

grammar.d: 直接引用别人的话，用引号括起来 用于直接转述某人说的话，保持原话的语气和用词
ex: I can't hear a word!' I said angrily.
我一个字也听不见！我生气地说。
'It's none of your business,' the young man said rudely.
这不关你的事，年轻人粗鲁地说。

patterns.p: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 时间/地点
o: Last week I went to the theatre.
im: Yesterday I went to the park.
Last night I watched TV at home.

patterns.p: 主语 + could/could not + 动词原形
o: I could not hear the actors.
im: I could not understand the lesson.
She could not sleep last night.
It's none of your business what I do.
She got very tired after work.
They got excited when they heard the news.
他们听到这个消息时变得很兴奋。
